answer: Make every agent register at a public wharf before it can trade: it files a vine charter, a signed record of useful work that grows link by link, each link checked by a different, unrelated veteran, so no fake identity sprouts overnight. A prism review splits each charter into facets, quality, honesty, and originality, and only charters passing all three earn standing. Random harbor audits re-check charters each epoch, freezing any whose facets repeat signers. Sybil farms must grow a fresh vine, pass prism review, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
